2116238163442106524.en_summary: Our firm’s back of the napkin math shows that Nvidia’s $NVDA ACIE segment could potentially overtake hyperscalers in two to six quarters. ACIE revenue grew faster at 138.5% vs 101.2%, QoQ 25% vs 13%. Conservatively overtake in 5-6 quarters at 14% QoQ vs 10%. Dell $DELL agrees, expecting enterprises and neoclouds to contribute half of AI data center capacity growth through 2030, $1 trillion TAM. Unlike hyperscalers, these customers lack budgets for custom chips and prefer ready-to-deploy servers from Dell and Super Micro $SMCI.
2116238163442106524.zh_summary: 我們公司的粗略計算顯示，Nvidia的$NVDA ACIE部門可能在兩到六個季度內超越超大規模雲端服務商。ACIE營收增長更快，為138.5%對比101.2%，環比25%對比13%。保守估計在5-6個季度以14%環比增長超越超大規模的10%。Dell $DELL同意，預期企業和新雲端將貢獻至2030年AI數據中心容量增長的一半，總可尋址市場達1萬億美元。與超大規模不同，這些客戶沒有預算購買定制芯片，更偏好Dell和Super Micro $SMCI的即時部署伺服器。

ticker_notes.NVDA: ACIE segment growth may overtake hyperscalers in 2-6 quarters, more resilient revenue.
